Players Committee card image of [[Kylo Ren (Errata 5)]] (errata PC-E5), game text: “Adds one destiny to total power when with a [First Order] shuttle. While present at a battleground, Honor Of The Jedi is suspended. Whenever a player loses a battle here, that player loses 2 Force. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/kylorenwb.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e 5637ac6] (12 December 2025). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
